_comment: TEMPLATE - copy to data/seed/profile.json and fill in. Keep one fact per entry: a citation should point at exactly one claim. scripts/seed_memory.py ingests this via the canonical writer path and is idempotent, so re-running only adds what is new. Note /data/ is gitignored on purpose - never commit real profile data.

_fields.text: required, the fact itself, first person
_fields.category: identity | professional | interests | personal | travel | knowledge
_fields.importance: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW (HIGH is preferred in ranking)
_fields.sensitive: true marks DOB, address, employer, family - set for anything you would not paste publicly
_fields.people: facet list, matched exactly by recall

facts.text: My full name is EXAMPLE PERSON.
My date of birth is 1 January 1990.
I currently live in EXAMPLE CITY.
I work as a EXAMPLE ROLE at EXAMPLE EMPLOYER.
I am interested in EXAMPLE HOBBY.
